correctness.rationale: The number of successor-colour neighbors of any vertex currently colour c equals the global population n_(c+1), since no vertex can be its own successor. All vertices of one colour update together. Zero, one, two, three large positive populations (>=theta) give respectively fixed, one-step merger to fixed, two-step merger to fixed, or primitive 3-cycle; two-colour states merge or are fixed. Thus only (0,1),(1,1),(2,1),(0,3) orbits occur. Counting positive small/large labelled colour blocks yields the four EGF formulas with coefficients (1,3,3,1), and two-colour contributions are separate binomial sums. Three large counts exist iff N>=3theta; exactly two large plus one small is possible iff theta>=2 and N>=2theta+1. For iid uniform colours, multinomial CLT on the two-dimensional sum-zero plane gives covariance diag(2/9), offdiag(-1/9), and the triangle of area 9delta²/2 has density 3sqrt(3)/(2pi), giving Psi(delta)~27sqrt(3)delta²/(4pi). At theta=floor N/3, N=3m+r, admissible offsets are r nonnegative components in binom(r+2,2) ways; 2D local CLT gives N*P→binom(r+2,2)*3sqrt(3)/(2pi). Independent direct vertex-update enumeration for all n=3..7, theta=1..n+1, 30 pairs confirmed exact eventual preperiod classifications; it is not an all-N proof.
residual_risks: Uniform iid initial colours and integer contact threshold are essential for probabilistic constants. The result does not extend automatically to spatial graphs, asynchronous updates or other numbers of colours.
